model.name: LFCC two-timescale + channel consistency

training.notice: LFCC research baseline; no claim of real-world reliability.

selection.objective: minimize worst absolute development EER, then clean EER, among candidates satisfying the clean-EER guardrail
selection.guardrail_basis: initial selected development clean EER 8.5106% plus 2 percentage points
selection.note: This round followed an initial test robustness failure. All changes in this round were selected using development data; the initial test report is retained.

model.warning: Research baseline; scores are not calibrated probabilities or proof of fraud.

notes: EER uses raw scores, including abstained clips; abstention coverage is reported separately.
Localization uses a separate 0.5s head, >=50% synthetic overlap labels and a fixed development-bin threshold.
Bins ending before 2s are warm-up, counted as genuine for localization; all bins remain in the denominator.
G.711 A-law/mu-law plus a 300–3400Hz bandpass simulate telephone effects, not real call capture.
CPU timing is measured on this computer; actual streaming may include additional browser/network latency.

phase2.phase1_comparison_caveat: Valid only with the same Phase 1 test set and protocol.
